Nina (infra): Morning — saw EU-West degrade around 07:12, small-chat route went >95th pct SLO. Looks tied to fallback churn.
Jesse (proxy): Confirmed. Proxy logs show a spike in fallback attempts -> global endpoints for ~2m window. fanout_count per-request went up to 8 in traces.
Priya (ops): Affected tenants: ~30 pref-local, 5 strict-residency (those were blocked). Ops manually throttled a set of client routes to stabilize.
Lukas (privacy): Reminder: strict-residency cannot be routed off-shore. Any automatic fallback must respect tenant flag.
Jesse (proxy): Thinking out loud: we need a pre-fallback admission gate in proxy that answers: safe_to_fallback? It should be microsecond-fast and pure (no blocking IO).
Jesse (proxy): Possible header contract: 
``
X-Residence: eu-west
X-Residency-Policy: strict|prefer-local|allow
X-Proxy-Decision: accept|defer|deny
```
Nina (infra): If decision == defer we return 429 + Retry-After, and increment metric `proxy.admit.decision=defer`. If deny -> 403 for strict cases.
Priya (ops): Also need operator override: allow-override=true, but override must be gated by two approvers and logged to audit. Manual only.
Lukas (privacy): Agreed. Overrides need immutability in audit log and retention 7 years for legal.
Jesse (proxy): For perf: admission gate should consult an in-memory cache of tenant flags + a tiny congestion estimator (local queue length + recent CPU load). TTL ~20s for flags. On cache miss, default safe_denial for prefer-local to avoid leaking.
Nina (infra): Also add `max-fanout` enforcement: a per-request header counter. If fanout_count > N, proxy stops further downstream calls and returns 503. Short-circuiting avoids loops.
Priya (ops): Suggest N=3 initially. We can expose runtime knob per-region.
Jesse (proxy): We'll also implement tokenized canary sampling: when global fallback is allowed we sample 0.2% of requests to global-canary route to observe prefix cache behavior under load. Sampling rate adjustable.
canary-bot: Canary report: sample=0.2% -> observed cache-hit reduction 12% on global hot-path in first 5m during test ramp.
Priya (ops): Good. How do we prevent a partial canary from amplifying load back to origin region?
Jesse (proxy): Canary should use a shadowed path with separate capacity pool and limited concurrency. Also tag requests so metrics are separate.
Lukas (privacy): We must ensure sampled canary does not violate residency. Only run canary for non-strict tenants; strict-residency requests must be excluded before sampling.
Nina (infra): Observability: emit `proxy.admit_decision`, `proxy.fanout_count`, `proxy.residency_block` and a histogram of `admit_latency_us`. Alert on >0.5% defers in 1m window.
Jesse (proxy): Perf budget: admit decision <= 1ms p99, no blocking RPCs. Implementation: local cache + tiny stateless estimator. If estimator uncertain, return defer.
Priya (ops): Rollout: feature-flag gated, staging smoke -> canary in eu-west -> small cross-region canary with ops supervision -> ramp. Include kill-switch.
Jesse (proxy): Also adding header hints for clients: `X-Residency-Safety: enforced` and `X-Proxy-Reason: overload|residency|fanout` so customers get actionable errors.
Lukas (privacy): Make sure error messages don't leak internal topology. Use opaque codes and link to KB article.
Priya (ops): Playbook notes:
- Detect sustained increase in `proxy.admit.decision=defer`
- If strict-residency tenants are stuck, coord with legal and use manual override flow
- If prefer-local churn is causing global amplification, reduce sampling to 0 and escalate to infra
- Use emergency `safe-default=deny` toggle per-region if legal exposure is suspected
Nina (infra): I'll open a follow-up RFC: admission-gate + max-fanout + canary-sampling + operator-override playbook. Draft will include sequence diagrams and cache consistency model.
Jesse (proxy): I'll prototype admit logic and a test harness to measure p99 decision latency. Expect PR by EOD.
Lukas (privacy): I'll send minimal legal text for overrides and audit requirements.
Priya (ops): Once RFC is in, ops will prepare runbook snippets and test incident run.
Jesse (proxy): Quick TODOs: add headers contract, metrics, sampling toggle, max-fanout enforcement, operator-override audit hook.
Nina (infra): Great. Ping @here when PR lands. :white_check_mark:
